children: USA Compression Partners entered into an Indenture to issue $600 million of 6.750% senior notes due 2035. The notes, issued under Rule 144A/Reg S, are guaranteed on a senior unsecured basis by certain subsidiaries and will pay interest semi-annually starting April 1, 2027. Proceeds will be used to repay borrowings under the partnership’s credit agreement and cover offering expenses. The Indenture includes customary covenants and redemption provisions.
: Indenture for $600 million 6.750% senior notes due 2035 with guarantees
: Refinance borrowings under credit agreement and pay offering costs
